title: Ember-Throat Jackal
text: Ember-Throat Jackal tracks warm blood through cold ash before closing in with furnace-bright jaws. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: It learned court manners from the execution yard.

defeatReward.text: Ember-Throat Jackal is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
